before.html:
Using the method of polynomial division, we obtain the following:

2x2−2x+13x2+12x2−2x+16x4−6x3+5x2−8x+72x2−2x+16x4−6x3+3x2―2x2−2x+18x4−4x3−2x2−8x+72x2−2x+18x4−4x3−2x2−2x+1―2x2−2x+18x4−4x3+6x2+x+6

As a result,

  • the quotient is 3x2+1, and

  • the remainder is x+6.

Therefore, 6x4−6x3+5x2−x+72x2−2x+1=3x2+1+x+62x2−2x+1.
